name: Brakel (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Brakel (a red castle with three towers on white).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident Detmold of 19 December 1974 the city was permitted to bear arms, banner, flag and seal; the flag is green and white striped with the city shield shifted from the centre towards the staff.

features.role: Brakel arms — red castle on white
